title: Red Shoes
alt: Nico, Gina, Leyslie, and Jake encounter a friendly police officer during an evening pizza walk in Mérida.
summary: A friendly police officer notices Jake’s red dog boots, forcing Nico’s baby Spanish into action.
body:
One evening in Mérida, Gina, Leyslie, Jake, and I walked from our casa through the barrio to pick up a Little Caesars pizza.

On our way home, a police truck pulled beside us. The officer leaned out and said:

“Buenas noches, ese es un perro enorme.”

Gina and Leyslie stayed silent, waiting for my baby Spanish to come out.

“Buenas noches, claro que sí.”

The officer continued, amused by Jake’s boots:

“Tu perro trae zapatos. Nunca había visto un perro con zapatos. ¡Qué chistoso!”

My brain buffered.

“Zapatos rojos.”

The officer smiled, waved, and drove away. We all started laughing while Jake side-eyed the pizza box.

A warm little Yucatán moment.

title: Cow Joke
alt: Nico tells Gina a terrible cow joke while driving through the Oregon countryside.
summary: Gina learns the hard way that every road trip with Nico comes with at least one spectacularly terrible dad joke.
body:
# Cow Joke

Driving through the Oregon countryside with Gina, we passed a field full of cows.

Like any mature adult, I immediately announced:

"Did you know starting in 2027 they can't make round hay bales anymore?"

She sighed.

"Are you serious? Why?"

I pointed toward the cows.

"Well... the cows were complaining about not getting..."

I paused for dramatic effect.

"...three square meals a day."

She buried her face in her hands.

"I hate you."

Totally worth it.
